newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat closes mostly down on exports.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat closes mostly down on exports.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures ended mostly lower on Thursday in very thin trading ahead of Friday's USDA crop report as lower-than-expected USDA export figures set a weak tone, traders said.
USDA on Thursday reported net wheat sales for the week ended Oct 3 totaled 296,200 tonnes, down 50 percent from the previous week and 40 percent below the four-week average.
Intermarket spreading was also noted as the CBOT/MGE spread narrowed. The December CBOT/MGE spread closed at four cents premium CBOT after trading at more than 10 cents last week, a trader noted.
ADM Investor Services and LFG Futures each bought 500,000 bushels Dec and Wilson Trading bought one million March on the day, traders said.
Cargill Investor Services bought and sold 500,000 Dec and Benson Quinn sold 500,000 Dec outright, traders said.
December barley futures were unchanged with an estimated volume of two contracts.
Wheat closed four cents per bushel lower to one cent higher with December down 2-3/4 at $4.20. Barley was unchanged with December at $6.99 per cwt.
